member.name: T:Sentinel.EntityFrameworkCore.Services.SecurityCacheCleanupService
member.summary:
Background service responsible for cleaning up expired entries from security caches. Prevents database disk exhaustion DoS attacks by periodically removing stale JTI, nonce, and session entries.
This service runs every 15 minutes to ensure timely cleanup of expired security cache entries. Failures in cleanup operations are logged but do not prevent the application from continuing. All cache implementations follow fail-closed semantics: cleanup failures do not affect query operations.

member.name: M:Sentinel.EntityFrameworkCore.Services.SecurityCacheCleanupService.ExecuteAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Executes the background cleanup task every 15 minutes. Errors in individual cache cleanup operations do not cascade; all cleanup tasks are attempted regardless.
